items.summary: Schwab Advisor Services' digital onboarding now lets firms add PDF forms to digital envelopes and countersign their own documents.
Syntax Direct personalized indexing is now available through iRebal without changing existing workflows.
Clients can eAuthorize wires and checks submitted via Import Transactions, with up to 2,000 transactions per upload.

Jotform's pricing page advertises a limited-time Black Friday discount on annual plans (not Enterprise); no dates or amounts are shown publicly. Listed prices are unchanged: Bronze $39, Silver $49, Gold $129 monthly.
Ester tax and estate planning is now available to all advisors in Schwab Advisor Center at no additional fee.
Claude Desktop now lets users choose a release channel: Stable (default, fewer updates) or Latest (a new version roughly daily).
Claude Meetings is rolling out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans; Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant to take notes, answer questions and build artifacts.
Wealthbox now integrates with Osaic's eQuipt platform. Osaic-affiliated advisors can push or pull a client profile on demand, with a side-by-side view to choose which fields update.

The unified Chat and Cowork experience turns on by default for Enterprise organizations whose admins hadn't set it; it needs Chat and code execution enabled and excludes zero-data-retention, HIPAA-ready and customer-managed-key orgs.
Morningstar's 11-12-26 update fixes ETF and closed-end fund 3-year standard deviation showing an outdated month, removed watchlist items reappearing, and embedded video sizing.
Google Calendar now syncs guest additions with third-party calendars such as Outlook: the organizer is notified when a guest adds guests, and the event updates when such a notice arrives.
Gemini Notebook can now build a site from a chat prompt, opening it in a new tab; rollout started November 16 on web for users 18 and older.
Google Meet adds an optional setting that shows participants a clickable link to the presented Docs, Sheets or Slides file; it is off by default.
Wealthbox AI Agents are now available on every plan, starting with 24 pre-built agents plus the ability to build custom ones that run on a schedule or when records change.
Formula Fields arrive on Premier and Enterprise plans, calculating numbers and dates that show on records, report columns and filters.
Wealthbox is available in Apple CarPlay on all plans for voice-created contacts, notes and tasks and asking about your day; it needs iOS 26.4 or later and a CarPlay-compatible vehicle.
Wealthbox Vault is a $29 per user per month add-on with unlimited file storage, full-content search, file versions and a Compliance Monitor role; AI document features are included on every plan.
Wealthbox opened an MCP-based Developer Portal for approved technology partners to build and submit AI integrations; Holistiplan and Nitrogen integrations are already available.
Zocks adds prefilled, validated Schwab account opening (Ultimate plan) and live Schwab balances, positions, cost basis and gains in Meeting Prep, Ask Anything and forms on all plans.
Zocks adds Collaborative Booking for multi-participant scheduling, customizable scheduling email templates and two dedicated Administrative Assistant roles.

Altruist launched donor-advised funds with no minimums and fees from 50 bps, plus household rebalancing with asset location at no extra cost, paperless security journaling for eligible same-client accounts, off-model manual trades and bulk DRIP settings.

RightCapital's Q3 2026 update adds an Iris Find Opportunities preset and document uploads, renames and enhances the Medicare module as Health Care, adds bulk CSV transaction import, and updates student-loan planning for the repayment-plan changes.
Holistiplan launched a Strategy Library of pre-built tax planning scenarios and expanded document collection (IRS transcripts, pay stubs) and modeling (Schedule E, scenario analysis).
Addepar posted about enhanced reporting that replaces manual reporting steps with automated workflows.
Addepar added more than 1,000 geography-specific regional private fund benchmark views and enhanced management.
AdvicePay added a Resource Center icon on every page, clearer invoice reminders that send on the lead-time date, and a faster transfer-date filter.
